## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; mixed sector leadership with Utilities/Energy/Real Estate strong while Technology and Financials weak, supporting a neutral read with no clear directional conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Utilities lead: EXC (1W: +5.82% | 1M: +5.61%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +6.87% | 1M: +2.38%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate showing strength: EQIX (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +15.27%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: Technology sector (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -7.63%, 24 stocks) with MSFT (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND and AMD (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -13.68%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -2.40% | 1M: -2.24%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.16% | 1M: -3.00%) RECOVERY, EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +8.45% | 1M: -4.44%) RECOVERY, EQIX (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +15.27%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: TTWO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -17.08%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.01% | 1M: +14.54%) CORRECTION, EMR (1W: -6.17% | 1M: +1.51%) CORRECTION, AMD (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -13.68%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -21.87%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select tech and services names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W momentum: AMAT (1W: +12.23%), EL (1W: +10.16%), EOG (1W: +8.49%). Major divergence present across large caps (AAPL, NVDA, META, others) with 1W vs 1M mismatches—tactical caution advised.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed to weak; Technology (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -7.63%, 24 stocks) with AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +7.68%) ABOVE TREND offset by MSFT (1W: -3.31% | 1M: -13.10%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -21.87%) BELOW TREND and IBM (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Soft, Financials (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -1.62%, 20 stocks) shows dispersion with AIG (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +9.41%) ABOVE TREND but large-cap banks like JPM (1W: -2.98% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND; breadth negative—monitor earnings/credit headlines.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Cautious but mixed; Healthcare (1W: +1.26% | 1M: +2.85%, 17 stocks) has JNJ (1W: +2.79% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +5.48% | 1M: -12.94%) RECOVERY, while LLY (1W: -0.27% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND highlights idiosyncratic dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Neutral stance: favor selective exposure to Utilities, Energy and Real Estate leaders (EXC, EOG, EQIX) and reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names showing broad weakness (MSFT, ACN, IBM) while monitoring major divergence in mega-caps; style: mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +12.23% | 1M: +12.93%) ABOVE TREND, EOG (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +16.09%) ABOVE TREND, EQIX (1W: +7.88% | 1M: +15.27%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: IBM (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: -21.87%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -5.50% | 1M: -17.08%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Utilities (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +3.83%) and Energy (1W: +1.98% | 1M: +13.15%) given strong 1W leadership.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -7.63%) and Financials (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -1.62%) on recent weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch AMAT hold the weekly breakout behavior after +12.2% 1W for ABOVE TREND continuation; monitor AAPL for hold above its 1M support after CORRECTION (AAPL 1W: -3.41% | 1M: +3.55%); NVDA (1W: -0.30% | 1M: +0.94%) must clear weekly resistance to confirm a return from CORRECTION; IBM (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -14.20%) breaking recent lows would deepen BELOW TREND risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVDA (+60): NVDA (1W: -0.30% | 1M: +0.94%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines on AI chip expansion but price slightly down on the week, a slight divergence to monitor for accumulation vs distribution.  
(Overlap between sentiment list and provided returns is limited; NVDA is the clearest actionable cross-reference in the dataset.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
UNH (-60): UNH (1W: +5.48% | 1M: -12.94%) RECOVERY — negative headlines on probes/CEO shift while price shows short-term bounce, a divergence requiring follow-through.  
IBM (-50): IBM (1W: -10.61% | 1M: -14.20%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirmed by steep price decline.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style (no clear Growth vs Value leadership). AMAT ABOVE TREND, EOG ABOVE TREND and EXC ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while MSFT, ACN and IBM are BELOW TREND. Major divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, NVDA, META vs select cyclicals/defensives) is the key risk to monitor alongside mixed news sentiment on UNH and IBM.
